title: Ashoka and the Mauryan Empire
text: Ashoka was an ancient Indian emperor of the Mauryan Empire. His reign is associated with the spread of Buddhism.

title: Sanchi Stupa
text: The Great Stupa at Sanchi is an important Buddhist monument. It is traditionally associated with Emperor Ashoka.

title: Ancient Inscriptions
text: Ancient inscriptions provide information about rulers, historical events, places and religious traditions.
